title: verdict
description: The machine-readable parity roll-up published as `verdict.json` to the permanent artifact branch (default `design-parity/main`). One per run; the PR run loads it as the baseline to diff its candidate against `main`. Source of truth is the `BaselineSummary` TypeScript interface in `packages/action/src/baseline.ts`. Aligned with the compose-ai-tools reporting-branch contract (compose-ai-tools#1866); see `docs/report-format.md`.

formatVersion.description: Versions the verdict.json layout. Bumped only on an incompatible change (a renamed/removed field, a changed type, a tightened `required`); additive optional fields do not bump it, so consumers must ignore unknown fields. Mirrors the `formatVersion` the compose-ai-tools reporting-branch `manifest.json` carries.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp the baseline was assembled.

commit.description: The source commit the baseline was rendered from, when known (`GITHUB_SHA`).

direction.description: Which side was authoritative for this run (resolved; never `auto` here).

status.description: Worst verdict status across components (errors do not escalate it).

blocked.description: True only when the direction blocks PRs and at least one verdict failed.

tokens.description: Path (relative to the artifact root) of the published design-system DTCG token file, when the run exposed any tokens. Stable known location (`tokens/design-system.tokens.json`) so consumers — e.g. Claude Design's GitHub import — can link it directly off the report branch. Additive optional field; does not bump formatVersion.

warnings.description: Run-level warnings (unresolved components, fail-soft errors) that did not escalate `status`.

component.description: One component's roll-up entry. Carries the verdict status and finding count, not the full Finding objects — those live in the component's `report.html`. The finding/verdict vocabulary is documented in `docs/report-format.md`.

source.description: Design source the reference came from (`figma`, `stitch`, `claude-design`, `bundle`).

status.description: Whether the component produced a verdict (`ok`), had no candidate/reference (`skipped`), or failed soft (`error`).

verdict.description: The component's verdict status; present only when `status` is `ok`.

findings.description: Count of findings the verdict produced; present only when a verdict was produced.

report.description: Path to the component's `report.html`, relative to the artifact root.

note.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. why a component was skipped.
